description: This file defines metrics types, constants, and a PerformanceReport structure for collecting and validating client performance metrics in the Mattermost project.

classes.name: MetricSample
classes.description: Represents a single metric sample with type, value, and optional labels.

classes.name: PerformanceReport
classes.description: Represents a set of collected performance metrics from a client, including validation and label processing methods.

methods.name: GetLabelValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a label, returning a default if not present or invalid.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the performance report for correct version, timestamps, and recency.

methods.name: ProcessLabels
methods.description: Processes and returns key labels for the report, such as platform, agent, and network request group.
